scenario_data.body: It's been a few days since that fateful night.
I'm in the living room with Ren where she is treating my wound.
After a few minutes, the treatment is over with.

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "How could you be so clumsy as to fall down the stairs of your own place?"
After hanging the laundry out to dry, I slide pretty magnificently down the stairs.
When I bow my head, she just smiles gently.

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "Whatever you do to yourself, I'll be sure to fix right up!"
Then, as if she read my mind...

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "But don't you go out getting hurt on purpose!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (She says that, but I'm sure she'd always help me.)
...Although if I said that, she'd get mad,
so I decide to keep that fact to myself.
Sitting on the sofa, I decide to strike up a different conversation,

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "When are we going to let everyone else know about us?"
Even though we're dating, we haven't told anyone yet.

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "If we tell them, they're just going to tease us."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Yeah, but we can't keep it a secret forever, right?"
She speaks bashfully in a low voice.

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "I don't want to keep you a secret from anyone, William..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Geez! She just likes to have it both ways...)
All of the sudden, everyone's inside the living room.
All eyes are on my injury.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Get out of here! I just feel down the steps!"
I tell them how I came to be injured.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "So you fixed him up, huh Ren?"
Then, a devilish grin appears on Sayaka's face.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "You know, you've been awfully nice to William lately!"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "William doesn't have any dirt on you, does he?"
She quickly looks up in surprise.

scenario_data.speaker: Misaki
scenario_data.body: "Why are you holding out on me! want details!"
Meh, it was bound to happen sooner or later.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (But she really put some weight behind those words...)
All I can do is give a wry smile.
Aki smacks me on the back without warning.

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "I knew it... You've been seeing each other since that time you went out, huh?"
Her voice is so low, that I can't hear everything she's saying.
But then a small, lonely smile appears on her face.
As soon as I was feeling better, she smacked me again.

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Never mind! You just treat Ren right!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "If you make her cry, I'll kill you!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "I got it! Just stop hitting me!"
Later on, we run to Ren's room

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "A-ahaha! I guess they found out after all!"
Looking unhappy, she sits on her bed.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "It was going to happen sooner or later."
Still looking a bit peeved, she turns to me.

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "I guess you're right. It was bound to happen."

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "So, at least we don't have to keep it a secret anymore."

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "And there's no reason to hold back anymore, either."
Feeling funny, I look at her face.
Suddenly, I'm trying to catch my breath.
Sitting on her bed, her face is red as a cherry...
She stares at me as if she's waiting for something.

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "Are you going to force me to say it?"
My flustered apology causes her to laugh.

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "If you know what I mean then..."
I quietly take a seat next to her.
We awkwardly look into each other's eyes for a few seconds.
Perhaps because we were trying to keep our relationship a secret,
we had being restraining ourselves from...
As my heart beats out of my rib cage...
I lean in for our first kiss.
Our lips connect, and then, we part.

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "I've been waiting for that for a long time..."
Then, with a smallish grin on her face,
she leans in close enough for our noses to touch, and then...
That confession is enough to melt my heart away.
Our lips connect with each other one more time.
It is a moment that I wish could last forever...
